t: What Manufacturing Cost Model Database Is All About
title: What Manufacturing Cost Model Database Is All About
description: Manufacturing cost models break the unit cost: materials (often 50%+), direct labor, energy, tooling amortization, overhead allocation, and scrap. Should-cost analysis estimates the supplier's cost to negotiate fairly. Learning curves (Wright's law: cost drops ~15-20% per doubling) forecast. The model decides: make vs buy, automate vs manual, and where the margin lives. This database is the complete cost model: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
